ticker_news.title: One-Fourth Of America's Unemployed Are Now College Grads— Chamath Palihapitiya Warns Student Loans Are Fueling The Crisis
ticker_news.description: A new report reveals that 25.3% of unemployed Americans are college graduates, signaling a 'white-collar slowdown'. Venture capitalist Chamath Palihapitiya criticizes federal student loan policies, arguing they push students into unsustainable debt for degrees with diminishing value.
ticker_news.author: Rishabh Mishra

ticker_news.title: Producer Inflation Stays Hot, But Consumer Pullback Adds To Fed Cut Debate
ticker_news.description: September's Producer Price Index rose 0.3%, driven by energy prices, while retail sales grew slower than expected at 0.2%. Market expectations remain focused on potential Federal Reserve interest rate cuts in December.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari
